role: Krishna disguised as an old Brahmin who tests Barbarika (Khatu folk telling)
look: Elderly Brahmin; warm brown skin (not blue: the disguise holds); long white hair in a knot; white beard; white Vaishnava namam (urdhva pundra) with a red centre; sacred thread; cream dhoti; tulsi-wood mala; bare feet.
sourceNotes: Disguise as a Brahmin is from the Khatu folk telling (bhaktibharat katha). The namam is a design hint at who he really is.
notes: Detailed rig derived (2026-11-15) from the S01E01 rigs mandavya/standing-calm and mandavya/cursing-hand-raised by episodes/X001-barbarika-three-arrows/svg/derive-cast.py: white hair and beard, cream dhoti, tulsi mala, the Shaiva tripundra swapped for a Vaishnava namam, mouth closed. Both poses face right: flip when he stands on the right. No halo by design (he is in disguise). The first hand-drawn version is in episodes/X001-barbarika-three-arrows/svg/review/v1-characters/.
